purpose: isolated diagnosis and applicability assessment of worker scheduling, concurrency, GPU compositing and shared rendering
renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (0x00002C05) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
mode: headless system Chrome on Windows, local offline files

pointer.input: one synthetic pointermove per real rAF for 2 s
pointer.measurement: unique compositor presentation timestamps from table-presentation.mjs, median per variant and grade over cyclically ordered trials; the two experiments have independent current controls

alternatives.foregroundHint: will-change: transform on the table foreground WebGL output canvas; no claim that this creates a compositor layer
alternatives.duringScrollStrip: hold the existing scroll-time displacement strip at the same stationary scroll offset using a scroll event
alternatives.withoutDisplacement: remove only the table backdrop displacement URL, keep its blur and saturation
alternatives.tableForegroundOnly: retain full backdrop optics and dynamic CSS on all four components, skip WebGL drawing and output copies for the three non-table surfaces; changes their highlights and is a diagnostic only

sharedScene.measurement: instrumented high-motion fixture. Count shared WebGL contexts, linked programs, drawArrays and drawImage from the shared canvas during 120 rAF-driven pointer inputs, and for 300 ms after an idle settle. Timed trials run separately without the counting hooks.

workers.job: two different cold-cache displacement maps until both PNGs decode in the main document
workers.method: Use the shipped glassNormals and outlineAt with the geometry, optics and full PNG reference taken from the rendered table and media viewer. Clear the map cache for every job. Main thread uses the original synchronous 2D canvas and toDataURL. Workers use the same pixel math and OffscreenCanvas.convertToBlob with PNG output. Both outputs are decoded on the main thread. Compare SHA-256 over all decoded RGBA bytes with each actual component after timing; 100 maps in 50 batches passed. Test runs on an isolated page, excluding DOM mounting and final filter composition.
workers.schedule: each batch needs two distinct maps; warm pools are already started and exercised, cold pools are started as part of timing. One worker processes two jobs serially, two workers process one each. Five modes use cyclic order across ten rounds.
workers.responsiveness: per-batch largest interval between main-thread requestAnimationFrame callback entries across the measured work until the next two callbacks, then median over ten rounds
